Behavior.Name: Terrain Surface
Behavior.Hint: Extrude this region's sight-restricting Define Surface downward as solid terrain. Add a Define Surface behavior to this same region and give its selected bottom or top a finite elevation. Lower viewpoints cannot see through its footprint; viewpoints at or above the surface can see across it. This affects sight only. Set token elevation when climbing onto the terrain.

Errors.Backend: Terrain Surface could not activate because another module replaced Foundry's sight polygon backend. Disable the conflicting vision module and reload.
